c05ad2593f.q: What does tokenization mean in the context of real estate investment?
c05ad2593f.a: Tokenization in real estate means converting ownership of a property or a share of a property into a digital token on a blockchain. Instead of buying a whole building or even a traditional REIT share, you could theoretically own a fraction of a specific property represented by a digital token. It makes real estate investment more liquid, more accessible, and a lot more complex from a compliance and operations standpoint.
c05ad2593f.e: Real Estate’s New Jobs — The Roles Emerging in a High‑Tech Property Market

9181ff86ae.q: What job roles are emerging around real estate investment platforms and tokenization?
9181ff86ae.a: Specific roles include head of digital assets and tokenization, lead product manager for tokenization, and Institutional Tokenization Origination and Structuring roles at major institutions like SS&C Technologies, NASDAQ, UBS, Bullish, and Coindesk. These roles involve designing and launching tokenized real estate products for institutional investors, structuring legal and financial wrappers around tokenized assets, and managing relationships with institutional clients.

The error of spreadsheet speed is over and what matters now is evidence quality across the entire property system.

Instead of one general chatbot, there are three specialized tools with different jobs.
